sentences.en: He made a killing by speculating on the stock market.
sentences.zh: 1. 他在股票市场投机成功赚了一大笔。

sentences.en: I am speculating that he may win the game.
sentences.zh: 2. 我猜测他可能会赢得这场比赛。

sentences.en: As to what happened there, one can only speculate.
sentences.zh: 3. 关于那里发生了什么，只能猜测了。

senses.zh: 思索; 猜测, 推测
